name: duzelt-ai
description: AI Türkçe Metin Düzeltici bakım ve paketleme araçları

scripts.site:preview: npm run site:prepare && wrangler dev --config wrangler.site.jsonc --local --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
scripts.site:check: npm run site:test && npm run test:feedback && python3 tools/prepare-site.py --check && node --check site/assets/js/config.js && node --check site/assets/js/site.js && node --check site/assets/js/feedback.js && node --check worker/index.mjs && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.site.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.site:deploy: npm run site:prepare && npm run site:check && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.site.jsonc
